question.text: A NIFTY 25000 long call bought at Rs. 120 premium. At expiry NIFTY 25400. Net P&L per unit:

explanation.text: The Logic: Payoff = max(25400-25000, 0) = 400. Net = 400 - 120 = Rs. 280. The Trap: Other values miss premium or intrinsic. Cross-Exam Context: Option payoff calc. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use structured option strategies (spreads) to cap premium cost.
